subject: Recap + next steps: HIPAA requirements, BAA availability & deployment options
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Hussain <samir.h@clearvista.health>, Elena Moreno <elena@clearvista.health>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps: HIPAA requirements, BAA availability & deployment options

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Below is a short recap and proposed next steps so we can align on PHI handling and hosting options for ClearVista's ingestion pipeline.

Call summary:
- ClearVista goal: ingest clinical notes and structured EHR fields to power triage & summarization features.
- Primary constraint: must be able to process PHI for pilot (on patients with signed consent) with auditability and strong key management.
- Evaluation target: Dedicated or Private deployment preferred; interested in timeline and evidence for SOC 2 / BAA.

Redwood summary / answers from call:
1) BAA availability
   - Redwood will sign a BAA. Standard BAAs are available for Dedicated and Private deployments.
   - For Hosted customers we offer BAAs in select cases after an elevated security review and contractual addenda (requires SSO, CSP peering, and data handling acceptance).
2) PHI handling boundaries
   - PHI-supporting deployments: Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (VPC/on-prem) are our recommended paths for PHI with full audit logs and customer-managed keys.
   - Hosted API: possible for limited PHI on a case-by-case basis; needs scoping and agreement on data retention and access controls.
3) SOC 2 status
   - We completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025. Type II audit is in progress; vendor-summary attached with expected completion target of Aug 2026.
4) Model & data residency
   - Models run inside the selected deployment (no third-party model weights leave the customer's VPC for Private). For Dedicated, runtime and KV cache live in the dedicated pool controlled by Redwood but isolated to customer tenancy; we provide audit logs and optional customer-managed keys.

Proposed next steps:
- Samir/Elena: confirm whether you want Redwood to provision a Dedicated pool for a pilot (we can size a 2-GPU canary). Reply with expected monthly QPS and sample sequence length.
- ClearVista: complete the attached vendor security questionnaire (vendor-questionnaire.xlsx) and return to us by Jun 5 if possible.
- Redwood (Priyom & Vivek): provide SOC2-summary.pdf, BAA-template.docx, and a short architecture diagram for Dedicated PHI (attached).

Attachments (attached to this thread): SOC2-summary.pdf, vendor-questionnaire.xlsx, BAA-template.docx, serving-architecture.png

Thanks — I’ll follow up mid-week to check on the questionnaire.

-Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Samir Hussain <samir.h@clearvista.health>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: HIPAA requirements, BAA availability & deployment options

Thanks Neha — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we loop procurement:

1) SOC 2 timing — you mentioned Type II expected Aug 2026. Is there a formal audit engagement letter or interim report you can share? Our security team typically needs evidence of controls in place.
2) For Hosted BAAs, what subset of PHI scenarios are supported? Is there a published list of allowed data types or a whitepaper?
3) Regarding model residency: will model inference ever route tokens to third-party services (e.g., cloud vendor-managed model hosting outside the dedicated pool)? We need confirmation that inference and KV cache remain within the customer tenancy for the Dedicated path.

I’ve attached our initial vendor questionnaire — we started filling some sections but left control descriptions blank (see attached vendor-questionnaire.xlsx). Can Priyom or Vivek weigh in on the technical controls?

Also, for sizing: our pilot will process ~30 rps at 512 tokens average per call during business hours.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement would like the questionnaire and SOC evidence by Jun 10 to keep our timeline.

-Samir
Director, Product Ops | ClearVista Health
samir.h@clearvista.health | +1 617-555-7890
(Attachment: vendor-questionnaire.xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Hussain <samir.h@clearvista.health>, Elena Moreno <elena@clearvista.health>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: HIPAA requirements, BAA availability & deployment options

Samir — great questions. Priyom and Vivek added the technical notes below; I also attached the documents we referenced.

Vivek (security) — SOC2 / audit evidence:
- We can share the interim SOC 2 readiness report and the auditor engagement letter. Latest readiness report attached as SOC2-summary.pdf. Final Type II report expected Aug 2026; we’ll provide interim control evidence (policies, control descriptions) this week.

Priyom (solutions engineering) — technical controls and model residency:
- Dedicated pool: inference, KV cache, and telemetry live in the dedicated tenant (no cross-tenant routing). We do not route token payloads to external model services outside the dedicated environment.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer maintains networking; inference happens within your VPC or on-prem nodes.
- Hosted: by default multitenant and not recommended for PHI unless we stand up a tailored hosting arrangement (single-tenant overlay + contractual controls). There is not a simple checklist for "allowed PHI fields" — instead we qualify by deployment model and controls (key management, retention, logging).

Answers to your bullets:
- Interim audit documents: attaching SOC2-summary.pdf and the auditor engagement letter (excerpt included in the PDF).
- Vendor questionnaire: Priyom will fill the technical control sections and return by Jun 4.
- Sizing: 30 rps at ~512 tokens — recommended starting configuration is a 2x A10G (or equivalent) dedicated pool with autoscale headroom; we’ll provide an expected latency/cost estimate in the next note.

Next steps / timeline:
- Jun 3: Priyom shares completed technical sections of the questionnaire.
- Jun 5: ClearVista returns the completed questionnaire.
- Jun 8: Redwood provides detailed sizing/costs and draft BAA.

If that timeline works I’ll get Procurement aligned on the BAA template.

-Neha
